messages:
Danielle W.: Heads up — hitting a bunch of mypy/pyright errors when using the autogenerated models from python-sdk v0.9. The generated response models are all typed as Any, so our consumers lose type safety. Example:
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = await client.chat.create(prompt="hi")
# resp is Any, so resp.output[0].text has no type info
```

Samir K.: Hmm. I remember the generator uses a very small pydantic surface right now. It doesn't produce TypedDicts or generics for response envelopes — mostly BaseModel with extra fields as Any.

Danielle W.: Right — mypy shows a ton of 'Value of type "Any" is not indexable' in our handlers. Pyright complains differently but same root cause.

Evan T.: Do we have a spec to map to typed models? The OpenAPI-ish schema from the service would let us produce proper Optional[...] and List[...] annotations.

Samir K.: We do, but the generator flattens union/oneOf in a lossy way currently. Also async client methods are annotated as -> Any instead of -> Response[Model].

Danielle W.: Quick repro attached in thread (small sample app). Can we make generator emit a generic Response[T] and parametrize operations? Even a minimal improvement would help our internal libs.

Lucy (devex): +1 — DX hit. A couple asks from users: 1) typings for params (e.g., max_tokens: int), 2) typed streaming chunks for async iteration, 3) clear mypy/pyright examples in the repo. Could we add a tiny typed sample under examples/typed_chat.py in the SDK? :eyes:

Samir K.: Plan proposal:
- Add Response[T] wrapper type and update method stubs to return Response[Model] for non-streaming calls.
- Improve generator mapping for oneOf -> Union and nullable fields -> Optional.
- For streaming, yield TypedChunk objects instead of raw dicts.
- Add mypy/pyright CI job that runs the examples (with strict-ish config).

Danielle W.: That sounds great. I can send a draft PR that changes the generator template; will include a minimal example and tests.

typechecker-bot: Created issue INF-1234: "python-sdk: improve generated typing for responses and streaming" assigned to @samir_k.

Evan T.: One more note — ensure pydantic v2 compatibility in generated code (BaseModel vs dataclass compatibility). Several customers on pydantic v1 will be sensitive, but our SDK pinned version should be explicit.

Samir K.: Good catch. We'll gate generation on pydantic_version variable and emit compatible shims.

Lucy (devex): Can we also document how to opt-out of generated models (some teams prefer raw dicts)? Add a flag in the SDK config to return raw dicts when needed.

Danielle W.: Yep, that's useful for quick hacks. I'll include returns_raw_model: bool in my PR example.

Samir K.: Filing a tracking RFC with the generator diffs and CI changes. Targeting v0.10.0-alpha for initial rollout. Leaving INF-1234 open for follow-up. :+1:

Danielle W.: Thanks — I started the PR draft and linked the example. Will ping once it's ready for review.

Lucy (devex): Thanks all — this will make onboarding and sample apps much smoother.

typechecker-bot: INF-1234 updated: labels [bug, enhancement, priority-high].
